facts.fact: SME South Africa's page says businesses trading 6+ months with turnover of R80,000 or more a month could qualify for funding up to R10 million.
facts.quote: Trading 6+ months and turning over R80,000 or more a month? You could qualify for funding up to R10 million

facts.fact: SME South Africa's funding offer, as described on the page, requires no business plan and no collateral, and uses a bank or accounting data connection for a fast decision.
facts.quote: no business plan, no collateral, just connect your bank or accounting data for a fast decision

facts.fact: The article's listed update date is September 9, 2024.
The article's footer states it was originally published in 2024 and updated in September 2026, which conflicts with the September 9, 2024 update date shown at the top of the page.
The article lists its reading time as 2 minutes.
The article states that marketing activity collecting customer personal information must be handled in line with the Information Regulator's requirements.
facts.quote: Where marketing activity collects customer personal information, it must be handled in line with the [Information Regulator’s](https://inforegulator.org.za/) requirements
